purpose: Initial Material x Risk Factor Knowledge Base for MXIS Care-model-v1 rule/scoring engine.
principles: Use numeric thresholds only when directly stated by a source or conservatively derivable from a stated preservation range.
Separate observable exposure, material-specific inference, care decision, and inspection trigger.
Prefer official conservation institutions for thresholds; use brand official guides for product-specific care actions and scope.

schema.risk_factor: humidity | temperature_heat | dryness | uv_light | physical_shock_abrasion | continuous_usage_rest
schema.applicability: What product/material context this row can be applied to.
schema.evidence_strength: A = conservation institution / peer-reviewed or official brand + conservation agreement; B = official brand or conservation guidance without material-specific threshold; C = expert/trade support only.

threshold_candidates.value: number or range, null when no threshold is supported.
threshold_candidates.notes: How to use or why not to use.

schema.recommended_actions: Care actions suitable for user-facing decision engine.
schema.inspection_triggers: Conditions where MXIS should recommend expert/brand inspection instead of overconfident self-care.

entries.applicability: Finished/coated cowhide or calfskin luxury bags; not exotic skin.

threshold_candidates.notes: CCI recommended stable leather storage range.
Preventive caution/action threshold for mould and hydrolytic degradation risk; not a damage occurrence threshold.
Derived from CCI mould time bands: 90-100% RH for 2 days, 80% RH for 10 days, 70% RH for 100 days. Use as damage-supporting exposure, not probability.
Do not score without defining local baseline and sampling window.

degradation_mechanisms: Moisture can support mould, hydrolysis of collagen fibers, staining/blistering after water contact, and coating appearance change.
recommended_actions: If wet, blot/wipe immediately with soft lint-free cloth.
Store in temperate dry environment with dust cover.
Use shape support; avoid anti-humidity sachets that over-dry leather.
inspection_triggers: Visible mould or musty odour.
Blistering, staining, sticky/tacky coating, colour transfer after moisture.
Repeated RH >65% exposure with poor ventilation.

entries.applicability: Finished/coated cowhide or calfskin luxury bags.

threshold_candidates.notes: CCI recommended leather environment.
Radiator, hot display case, direct sun/window, car interior: avoid rather than numeric score.

degradation_mechanisms: Local heat accelerates deterioration through desiccation and protein denaturation; heat also shifts RH and can dry leather.
recommended_actions: Move away from radiator, window, car interior, or direct sun.
Dry wet leather at room temperature, not with direct heat.
inspection_triggers: Warping, stiffness, tacky finish, cracking, or colour alteration after heat exposure.

entries.applicability: Finished/coated cowhide or calfskin luxury bags.

threshold_candidates.notes: CCI: loss of moisture and embrittlement.

degradation_mechanisms: Moisture loss reduces flexibility, increasing embrittlement, cracking, and vulnerability during handling.
recommended_actions: Avoid over-drying and moisture-absorbing sachets unless brand/product-specific advice says otherwise.
Store covered in stable environment; avoid heaters and dry airflow.
inspection_triggers: New cracking, stiffness, powdery surface, or shape distortion after dry exposure.

entries.applicability: Dyed, painted, finished, or coated cowhide/calfskin bags.

threshold_candidates.notes: CCI max for unpainted leather display.
Use for dyed/painted/light-sensitive leather or conservative luxury colour protection.
CCI traditional maximum UV level.

degradation_mechanisms: Light damage is cumulative and irreversible; UV/visible light can fade dyes and weaken leather through photochemical degradation; IR/heat dries leather.
recommended_actions: Avoid direct sunlight and window display.
Store in dust cover/box away from light.
Limit cumulative display/exposure time.
inspection_triggers: Noticeable fading, yellowing, uneven colour, or cracking on light-exposed panels.

entries.applicability: Finished/coated cowhide/calfskin, especially corners, handles, and coated surfaces.

threshold_candidates.notes: Brands directly warn against rough/hard surfaces but do not give numeric limits.
Brands warn overpacking distorts shape; no weight threshold supported.

degradation_mechanisms: Abrasion wears grain/coating at corners and folds; overload deforms silhouette and increases strain at handles/attachments.
recommended_actions: Avoid hard/rough surfaces and floor placement.
Do not overpack; support shape in storage.
Wipe dust after each use with soft dry cloth.
inspection_triggers: Deep corner wear, coating loss, handle strain, torn stitch, loose hardware, structural deformation.

entries.applicability: Luxury leather bags subject to frequent daily use.

threshold_candidates.notes: Brands recommend rest/rotation but provide no exact day count.

degradation_mechanisms: Frequent uninterrupted wear concentrates abrasion, handle strain, body oils, dirt, and shape fatigue.
recommended_actions: Rotate use periodically.
Rest in dust cover with tissue/bubble support and straps positioned correctly.
Wipe after each use before storage.
inspection_triggers: Progressive shape collapse, handle deformation, persistent odour/soil, recurring corner wear despite care.

entries.applicability: Uncoated/natural full-grain or vegetable-tanned cowhide such as vachetta/natural leather.

threshold_candidates.notes: CCI recommended leather storage range.
Preventive caution/action threshold for mould/hydrolytic degradation; vegetable-tanned leather also vulnerable to darkening/stiffening in warm moist conditions.
Derived from CCI mould time bands. Treat as damage-supporting exposure, not confirmed damage.

degradation_mechanisms: Natural/vegetable-tanned leather can absorb moisture, stain, darken, stiffen, embrittle, and undergo hydrolytic breakdown under prolonged warm/moist conditions.
recommended_actions: Protect from humidity, water spray, and rain.
If wet, blot immediately with light-coloured lint-free cloth.
Avoid home remedies/oils/creams unless brand-approved.
inspection_triggers: Water stains before patina, mould, darkening plus stiffness, powdery surface, persistent moisture odour.

entries.applicability: Uncoated/natural full-grain or vegetable-tanned cowhide.

threshold_candidates.notes: CCI recommended leather environment.
Avoid radiators, hot display cases, car interiors, and sunlight.

degradation_mechanisms: Heat accelerates oxidation/hydrolysis and can desiccate leather; warm plus moist conditions increase vegetable-tanned leather darkening, stiffening, and breakdown.
recommended_actions: Keep away from direct heat and overheated car interiors.
Dry naturally at room temperature after water exposure.
inspection_triggers: Rapid colour change, new stiffness, cracks, or surface weakness after heat exposure.

entries.applicability: Uncoated/natural full-grain or vegetable-tanned cowhide.

threshold_candidates.notes: CCI threshold for moisture loss and embrittlement.

degradation_mechanisms: Loss of bound moisture causes embrittlement, cracking, and loss of flexibility; dry handling increases mechanical damage risk.
recommended_actions: Avoid desiccant/anti-humidity sachets for natural leather unless directed by maker.
Avoid heaters, dry vents, and prolonged dry storage.
inspection_triggers: Cracking, hardening, red/powdery surface, flaking, or loss of flexibility.

entries.applicability: Natural leather, vegetable-tanned cowhide, light-coloured leather, dyed leather.

threshold_candidates.notes: CCI max for unpainted leather.

CCI UV maximum.

recommended_actions: Avoid direct sunlight and prolonged window exposure.
Store in dust cover/box away from light.
inspection_triggers: Uneven patina, yellowing/fading, surface embrittlement on exposed side.

entries.applicability: Uncoated/natural cowhide and vachetta trims, which scratch and soil easily.

threshold_candidates.notes: Brand guidance supports rotation/rest but gives no exact interval.

entries.applicability: Suede/nubuck leather with nap; luxury bags, shoes, trims.

entries.applicability: Suede/nubuck leather.

threshold_candidates.notes: Leather baseline from CCI; suede-specific numeric range not found.

entries.applicability: Suede/nubuck leather.

entries.applicability: Cotton/fabric canvas, coated canvas, canvas with leather trims.

entries.applicability: Cotton canvas, dyed fabric canvas, coated/printed luxury canvas.

threshold_candidates.notes: CCI traditional level for textiles and sensitive collections.
CCI UV maximum; UV filtering alone is not enough, visible light level also matters.

degradation_mechanisms: Light fades dyes/prints and weakens textile fibers; UV causes yellowing, weakening, and disintegration. Printed canvas ink layers may abrade/fade at wear points.

Do not place directly on floor.
Avoid overpacking and heavy contents.

entries.applicability: Canvas/coated canvas bags under regular carry.

threshold_candidates.notes: Brand guidance supports periodic rotation/rest, no exact number.

degradation_mechanisms: Continuous use concentrates abrasion on corners/folds/bottom, pigment transfer, soil accumulation, moisture events, and shape fatigue.
recommended_actions: Rotate use periodically.
Wipe after use; store in dust bag with shape support.
Avoid storing other items on top.

model_notes.initial_scoring_recommendation: For v1, compute preventive exposure tiers from directly supported thresholds and source-backed dose bands, but phrase outputs as exposure/stress levels rather than disease probabilities.
preventive_tier_policy: Stable zone: preferred storage or low-exposure range.
Caution zone: stable zone breach or short/sustained exposure that should be corrected before visible change.
Elevated zone: repeated exposure, sensitive material plus direct event, or partial approach to damage-supporting source bands.
High zone: exposure reaches source-backed damage-supporting bands, such as CCI leather mould dose >= 1.0, but still does not mean confirmed damage.
Inspection required: visible symptoms or hard triggers, not sensor exposure alone.
model_notes.accelerated_ageing_policy: Leather accelerated-ageing papers support the mechanism that heat, humidity and time reduce leather stability, but their severe experimental conditions should be used as upper-bound evidence, not directly as everyday handbag thresholds.
unsupported_thresholds: Do not set shock g-force limits yet; source-backed luxury bag thresholds were not found.
Do not set exact continuous-use/rest day thresholds yet; brands recommend rotation/rest but do not quantify.
Do not set universal high-temperature damage threshold beyond recommended storage ranges and direct heat-source events.
next_research_targets: Leather finishing/coating-specific failure data for patent, polyurethane, acrylic, and pigmented finishes.
Luxury handbag repair expert interviews for practical inspection triggers.
Sensor validation: mapping bag microclimate readings to ambient RH/temperature and user event logs.
